samples.summary: Table cell borders still drop `dash` on PPTX export/import, the one stroke path this PR's dash round-trip did not reach
samples.evidence: `CellBorder` carries `dash?: 'solid'|'dashed'|'dotted'` (packages/slides/src/model/element.ts:435) and the canvas honours it (packages/slides/src/view/canvas/table-renderer.ts:314 — `dashArray(edge.stroke.dash, edge.stroke.width)`). The table exporter builds `<a:lnL/R/T/B>` by hand with only `w` + `solidFill` (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/table.ts:116-121) and never calls the newly shared `dashXml`; the table importer's `parseCellBorder` likewise reads only `solidFill` and `w` and never `prstDash` (packages/slides/src/import/pptx/table.ts:207-224). So a dashed table border persisted in the model (content PUT API, or any future UI) renders dashed on canvas but exports solid — the same asymmetry the delta just fixed for connectors, left open one file over. `dashXml` is now exported and directly reusable here.

searchedFor: grep parseShapeStroke call sites in packages/slides/src/import
finding.summary: Connector export drops the `dash` the new importer now reads, making connector round-trips lossy
finding.evidence: `parseShapeStroke` is shared by connectors: `packages/slides/src/import/pptx/shape.ts:1054` (inside `parseCxnSp`) calls it, so after this change an imported `<p:cxnSp>` whose `<a:ln>` carries `<a:prstDash val="dash"/>` arrives as `stroke.dash: 'dashed'` and is painted dashed by `connector-renderer.ts:50`. But the connector exporter builds its line by hand — `packages/slides/src/export/pptx/connector.ts:102-110` emits `<a:ln w=…>{solidFill}{headEnd}{tailEnd}</a:ln>` and never consults `stroke.dash` (it does not use `lineXml`, which is the only place `DASH_VAL`/`<a:prstDash>` is written, `export/pptx/shape.ts:152`). So import→export→import silently converts every dashed connector to solid. The round-trip suite does not catch it: the only connector fixture, `test/import/pptx/__fixtures__/build-rich-pptx.ts:373`, has no `<a:prstDash>`, and the new round-trip case added in this diff covers shapes only. Fix belongs in `connector.ts` (emit `<a:prstDash>`, ideally by reusing `lineXml`), or the importer should not record `dash` for connectors.

verdict.reason: The connector exporter already emits `<a:prstDash>` from `stroke.dash`. `packages/slides/src/export/pptx/connector.ts:137` computes `const dash = dashXml(stroke?.dash);` and line 140 interpolates it into the line element: `<a:ln w="${lnW}">${fillXml}${dash}${headXml}${tailXml}</a:ln>`, placing the dash after the fill and before the line ends per CT_LineProperties. `dashXml` (connector.ts:98-101) maps 'dashed'->dash and 'dotted'->sysDot and returns '' for solid/absent, mirroring the importer's DASH_BY_PRST at import/pptx/shape.ts:1024-1025. The finding's supporting claims are inverted: DASH_VAL is defined in connector.ts:92, and export/pptx/shape.ts:7 imports `dashXml` FROM `./connector.js` (used at shape.ts:136), so `lineXml` is a consumer of the connector helper, not the sole writer of `<a:prstDash>`. The quoted evidence range connector.ts:102-110 does not contain the `<a:ln>` construction in this tree. Coverage also exists outside the fixture the reviewer checked: test/export/pptx/connector.test.ts:73-120 asserts prstDash emission, sysDot, absence for solid, and ordering, and test/export/pptx/round-trip.test.ts:283-316 is a dedicated 'connector dash survives export and re-import' case asserting ['dashed','dotted',undefined]. Import->export->import therefore preserves connector dash; no lossy round-trip.
